text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
""This is Golshi. I've arrived on the 
scene. —Yeah, no mistake about it, they're 
HERE!""

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Dammit... How dare you destroy my treasure 
trove! That's a crime—a mortal sin!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, Stay Gold! Face me in a race!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...? What's that?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "It's a bed! A beeeeed!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I'm back. Man, she really left a mess 
here.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, even onto my bed... Yeah, 
guess I'll just shove it all over to her 
side.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
There we go...—Ah, part of it collapsed. 
Well, should be fine.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Give back their habitat! Give me 
back my king-sized bed life where I can 
roll around all I want in floof!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're such an overdramatic guy. 
It's not like I threw it away, so what's 
the big deal?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Listen, I got into this line of work 
because I'm obsessed with interior design 
down to the picometer!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Your bed belongs to me! It was decided 100 
million years ago when you moved out! 
Surrender it at once!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: No way. ...What if I said that?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'll give them my bed, and crawl into 
yours every night instead! It's gonna be 
tight~ And I'll make you my body pillow 
too~

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If you don't like it, fight me for it! 
We'll duel with your bed on the line!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Round 1: 'Treasure Stacking Duel'! Whoever 
stacks this junk the highest wins!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, what a spectacular mess you 
made again. Alright, I'll play along.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Not bad at all, Stego...! With 
this, we could even do the "dance of the 
bream" on top of Ryugol Castle...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course. You'll probably be the most 
popular guy on the whole beach, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"I'm never giving up my spot as the #1 
Undersea Idol! Do you have any idea how 
many fish-people wave their fins for 
Golshi-chan...?!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Concu...—Aaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: It is my victory.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next up is the 'Bed Dive Royale'! 
Whoever pulls off a soul-blasting dive 
crazy enough to make the King of the Sea 
bow down wins!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. So basically, I just gotta 
find a nice way to dive into bed.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Behold, the explosive force of 5.64 
million power level! GOLD SPIRAALLLLL!!! 
(*Simulation for illustrative purposes.)"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Golshi... Even a giant squid would fall 
asleep and start snoring at that rate."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wh... What'd you say...? Then show me. 
Show me the ultimate dive that'll make my 
heart tremble!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: There... heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No fair! If you do that, the sea surface 
temperature's gonna rise!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Gol-gol-gol-gol... Ah! Just now! A 
surging wave of an impulse broke the 
Golshi-chan Radar! DIVVVVVVE!!!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ah, hey—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Owwchhh!!! A wall just sprouted out of 
nowhere!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: You really went all out! Are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
My heart is shattered! Smashed to bits! 
Ah, the pieces scattered everywhere... and 
I can't find 'em!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha... You really don't know how to hold 
back. Seriously, you're out of control!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Did something happen? I heard a loud 
noise just now...!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...What a terrible mess. Could you be... 
in the middle of spring cleaning?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Well, pretty much. I'm just gathering 
up stuff I don't need.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's wonderful that you get along so 
well... Just please, try not to wreck the 
room, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, this wall's already got some real 
character. An honorable old scar from 
wrestling a megaton Giant Pacific Octopus 
for three days and three nights—still 
shines brilliantly today..."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Golshi. Let's go take out the trash 
for now.

While walking near the dorms, I spotted 
Stay Gold and Gold Ship.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, SteGo! Our battle isn't over yet, is 
it?
choice_data_list: What are you two doing together?
What are you two doing together?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Aah... We're in the middle of a serious 
match here. Hey, got any good topics?
choice_data_list: How about deciding it with a race?
How about we settle it with a simple game?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's race to the dorms with a 
"Hundred-Face Dash"! Keep those facial 
muscles and legs moving! Let your passions 
run wild! Ready, set, go!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Man, she's got way too much energy. ...See 
ya, Trainer!

With a gentle look in her eyes, Stay Gold 
took off running after Gold Ship.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's settle this with "this." 
It's a game with tradition. No complaints 
from you, right?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—The "Dog Game," huh? Very well. Trainer, 
would you mind acting as referee?

A "Dog Game" suddenly began. As the 
referee, I was dragged along until the sun 
went down...
